## E1 — Enter a round and take control of a ship

> *You pick one of four modes, appear beside the space station that is your base, and the ship answers the mouse or the keyboard. Nothing else in the game can happen until this has.*

## E2 — Mine the belt until the hold is full

> *You shoot asteroids and the crystals they drop are worth something. Bigger rocks pay more per shot and cost more to stay near. The hold has a ceiling and crystals past it are simply lost.*

## E3 — Convert a full hold into a better ship

> *A full hold goes into eight statistics, into an extra life, or into the next ship in the tree - and taking the next ship hands you an un-upgraded one. That trade is the decision the whole loop exists for.*

## E4 — Lose the hold, and then the ship, under fire

> *Shields absorb until they do not, and past that every hit knocks crystals out of your hold for anyone to take. Dying puts you back in a tier one ship with nothing.*

## E5 — Survive the closing field until one pilot is left

> *A repulsive field grows out from the star and pushes everyone inward, warning as it goes. The round ends when one player remains.*

## E6 — Hold the field against the invasion instead

> *One of the four documented modes replaces the last-survivor ending with waves of attackers and a final boss. It is a different arc to the same field, and leaving it out would leave a documented mode in no story.*
